description: This file defines enhanced decorators for the AgentField SDK, primarily focusing on a 'reasoner' decorator that wraps functions with automatic workflow tracking, metadata storage, and context management. It also includes utility decorators for memory event listening and legacy support for an older reasoner decorator signature.

methods.name: reasoner( func=None, *, path: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, track_workflow: bool = True, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Decorator for wrapping functions with workflow tracking, metadata, and context management. Supports both coroutine and regular functions, with optional parameters for customization.

methods.name: Any _execute_with_tracking(func: Callable, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Core internal function handling the execution of reasoner functions with context setup, workflow registration, and post-processing including success/error reporting.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_input_payload( signature: inspect.Signature, args: tuple, kwargs: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Utility to create a payload dictionary from function signature, positional args, and kwargs, excluding 'self' and applying defaults.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _compose_event_payload( agent, context: ExecutionContext, reasoner_name: str, status: str, parent_execution_id: Optional[str], input_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Builds event payload for workflow event reporting, including execution and agent context metadata.

methods.name: on_change(pattern: Union[str, List[str]])
methods.description: Decorator to mark a function as a memory change event listener, attaching pattern metadata.

methods.name: None _send_workflow_start( agent, context: ExecutionContext, payload: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Legacy async function emitting a workflow start event to the agent's workflow handler if available.

methods.name: None _send_workflow_completion( agent, context: ExecutionContext, result: Any, duration_ms: int, payload: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Legacy async function emitting a workflow completion event to the agent's handler.

methods.name: None _send_workflow_error( agent, context: ExecutionContext, message: str, duration_ms: int, payload: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Legacy async function emitting a workflow error event to the agent's handler.

methods.name: legacy_reasoner(reasoner_id: str, input_schema: dict, output_schema: dict)
methods.description: Legacy decorator maintaining backward compatibility with older reasoner decorators using reasoner ID and schemas.

methods.name: None _maybe_generate_vc( status: str, result_payload: Any, duration_ms: int, error_message: Optional[str] )

ctags.name: _build_input_payload
ctags.signature: ( signature: inspect.Signature, args: tuple, kwargs: Dict[str, Any] )

ctags.name: _compose_event_payload
ctags.signature: ( agent, context: ExecutionContext, reasoner_name: str, status: str, parent_execution_id: Optional[str], input_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )

ctags.name: _maybe_generate_vc
ctags.signature: ( status: str, result_payload: Any, duration_ms: int, error_message: Optional[str] )

ctags.name: _send_workflow_completion
ctags.signature: ( agent, context: ExecutionContext, result: Any, duration_ms: int, payload: Dict[str, Any], )

ctags.name: _send_workflow_error
ctags.signature: ( agent, context: ExecutionContext, message: str, duration_ms: int, payload: Dict[str, Any], )

ctags.name: _send_workflow_start
ctags.signature: ( agent, context: ExecutionContext, payload: Dict[str, Any] )

ctags.pattern: /^def legacy_reasoner(reasoner_id: str, input_schema: dict, output_schema: dict):$/
